India vs Uruguay Football Match Sees Low Turnout Despite Ticket Price Cuts

Despite a significant 90% price reduction on tickets, with some originally priced at ₹1,999 now available for ₹199, the Salt Lake Stadium in Kolkata saw a low turnout for the India vs Uruguay football match. Anirudh Thapa scored for India during the game.
